comment: Live harness inventory for the k7s Rust examples (B83). dev/run-harnesses.mjs reads this, runs each entry's prebuilt example binary against a live cluster, and records pass / skip / fail. `requires` lists the fixtures a harness needs before it's worth running; the runner pre-skips any harness whose fixtures aren't provisioned. Fixtures: kind (dev/cluster/up.sh), helm (dev/cluster/helm-fixture.sh), metrics (up.sh --metrics), multi (a second kubeconfig context).

harnesses.name: helm_check
harnesses.description: Helm release decode/reduce from storage Secrets

harnesses.name: helm_write_check
harnesses.description: rollback + uninstall fixture-app (writes; restore with helm-fixture.sh)

harnesses.name: live_check
harnesses.description: pod exec + port-forward against a live pod

harnesses.name: nodeshell_check
harnesses.description: node debug-shell admission (dry run by default)

harnesses.name: promql_check
harnesses.description: Prometheus backfill (self-skips without a Prometheus service)

harnesses.name: resilience_check
harnesses.description: typed failure classification + stale/recovery (creates a restricted SA)

harnesses.name: svc_forward_check
harnesses.description: Service targetPort resolution + a real tunnel

harnesses.name: terminal_check
harnesses.description: kubectl pty terminal bound to the viewed cluster
